items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I had a French friend of mine who was to move out of here.

ctx.x: See? Yeah. I moved out of here because I had a French friend of mine who was to move out of here. and he would like to move in here. And after he moved, I kept this place empty for three or four solid years. I had that picture last week when you was here. I got rid of that place in Florida Walk. I actually give it away to keep a fella from being sent back to Germany. Yeah. Yeah. I think it was in this... I moved back in here then. See?
It must have been... Did you ever know any other bands that played across the river there, Jack? Did you know of any other bands that played over on the other side?
